source: Earthdawn 4E Player's Guide — Namegiver races. Mechanics distilled into structured data; no verbatim rulebook prose. Ability 'summary' fields are original concise wording of the game effect.

abilities.name: Heat Sight
abilities.summary: Sees radiated heat as colour; allows seeing in the dark at the expense of detail. Fades as ambient light increases, does not penetrate objects, and is blocked by effects that block normal sight.

abilities.name: Strong Back
abilities.summary: +2 Strength for the purpose of determining carrying capacity only.

abilities.name: Low-Light Vision
abilities.summary: Sees at much lower light levels than humans; a single torch lights a large hall and starlight is ample. No extra susceptibility to flash-blindness. Complete darkness still blinds.

abilities.name: Versatility
abilities.summary: Adept-only racial talent allowing a human to learn talents from Disciplines other than their own. Human adepts begin with it at Rank 0 and raise it with Legend Points as a Novice talent. Non-adept humans cannot learn it.

abilities.name: Increased Wound Threshold
abilities.summary: +3 to Wound Threshold, reflecting stone-like resistance to damage.

abilities.name: Natural Armor
abilities.summary: Stone-like skin provides Physical Armor 3. Obsidimen can only wear 'living' armor, which adds to (rather than replaces) this natural armor.

effects.note: acts as a base; only living armor adds on top

abilities.name: Gahad
abilities.summary: A fierce situational impulse. When an ork gives in to (or fails to resist) a triggering situation, they gain +1 to Action or Effect tests aimed at ending the trigger or taking revenge. Resisting requires a Willpower (6) test and causes a 'hangover' (Harried). Largely roleplay; bonuses and application are at GM discretion.

abilities.name: Tail Combat
abilities.summary: Can strike with the tail as an unarmed attack (using an unarmed combat talent/skill), dealing Strength-Step damage. May instead attach a melee weapon of up to Size 2 to the tail (an Attached Weapon). Enables the Tail Attack combat option.

effects.note: may attach a melee weapon of up to Size 2

abilities.name: Astral Sight
abilities.summary: All windlings have access to the Astral Sight talent; adepts begin with it at Rank 0 and may raise it with Legend Points as a Novice talent.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.summary: Can fly (rate 16) but not indefinitely: after ~20 minutes aloft a Toughness (5) test is required, with a cumulative +2 per extra 5 minutes; failure costs 1 Strain. Wet wings cut flight time to 5 minutes, escalate the tests, and leave the windling Harried until dry.

effects.note: fatigue after ~20 min flight; see summary

abilities.name: Increased Physical Defense
abilities.summary: Small size and natural mobility add +2 to Physical Defense.
